findings.title: Reject concatenated signatures whose length differs from signLength
findings.body: concatenatedRSToASN1DER copies only the first signLength bytes without checking signature.length. An otherwise valid JOSE ECDSA signature with arbitrary bytes appended is therefore converted to the same valid DER signature and can pass verification, although JOSE requires an exact signature length. Short inputs instead produce an unchecked array-copy exception. Validate the input length and throw IOException for mismatches before copying.

findings.title: Exercise the actual ES384 and ES512 curve sizes
findings.body: All three tests generate an uninitialized EC key pair, which on the standard JDK defaults to P-256. Changing the hash algorithm to ES384 or ES512 does not change the curve, so those tests merely pad 256-bit r and s values and never exercise real P-384 or P-521 signatures. In particular, the ES512 test misses the long-form DER sequence length needed for P-521. Initialize the generator with the matching curve for each algorithm and verify the reconstructed DER signature with JCA, rather than only checking a round trip through the same implementation.
